# dbv-specs-ops activation

Before proposing code or a technical plan, read and follow `dbv-specs-ops/docs/MASTER_PROMPT.md`. Load configuration and project context from `dbv-specs-ops/project.config.md`, `dbv-specs-ops/docs/SPECIFICATIONS.md`, `dbv-specs-ops/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `dbv-specs-ops/memory.md`, and `dbv-specs-ops/task.md`.

Keep application source in the project root and framework control files inside `dbv-specs-ops/`.
